thread:
Sasha: Heads-up — planning to flip config_guardrails.enable_safe_default -> false tomorrow 10:30 UTC. This removes the safe fallback routing for model-x so we can validate the new routing policy. Need a deploy owner, smoke checklist, and rollback ready. Plan below.

Ryan: I'll own the deploy. Target 10:30 UTC, will be on-call and reachable. I'll kick it off from the infra rollout job.

Ana: I can run smoke checks and watch dashboards. Which dashboards should I prioritize?

Sasha: Prioritize latency/error dashboards (per-route p95/p99), model-fallback-rate, and kv-cache hitrate. Quick ops snippets: 

```
# toggle via config service
curl -X POST https://config.redwood.internal/v1/flags \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CI_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"key":"config_guardrails.enable_safe_default","value":false,"env":"prod"}'
```

Smoke request example:
```
curl -sS -H "x-rw-tenant:test-canary" https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke:short"}' | jq -r '.choices[0].text'
```

Rollback:
```
# rollback to safe default
curl -X POST https://config.redwood.internal/v1/flags -d '{"key":"config_guardrails.enable_safe_default","value":true}'
```

Ryan: Got it. I'll run a staged rollout: 5% for 15m -> 25% for 15m -> 100% if green. Will post job id when started.

deploy-bot: [deploy scheduled] job_id=job-87219 queued by Ryan for 2026-03-22T10:30:00Z

Liam: FYI I've prepped alerts: 1) errors >1% absolute spike, 2) p95 +200ms, 3) model-fallback-rate >0.5%. Ana will handle paging.

Ana: I'll watch traces and run the smoke suite every 5m for the first 30m after each stage. I'll ping @Ryan and @Sasha on anomalies.

Maya: Quick note — double-check routing exclusions for billing-critical tenants; we don't want them routed to the new path yet.

Sasha: Confirmed — I updated the config manifest to exclude billing routes: https://git.redwood.internal/configs/guardrails/commit/abcd1234

Ryan: job started: job-87219 -> canary 5% now. Posting first log: 10:30:05 canary traffic routed.

Ana: First 10m checks: no error spike, p95 +30ms, kv hitrate stable. Smoke request output matched template. Continuing monitor.

Liam: Lowered some alert thresholds for the first 30m; if anything crosses 0.8% errors I'll escalate.

Ryan: If 5% is stable after 15m, I'll promote to 25% for another 15m then decide on full cut.

Sasha: Agreed. Everyone standby for the hour. If we see regressions, rollback to true (safe default) and post the rollback job id here.

deploy-bot: [deploy complete] job_id=job-87219 status=success finished_at=1976543600

Ana: Final check at end of staged 45m: no regressions observed, p95 steady, no increase in failed requests. Recommend promote to 100%.

Ryan: Promoted to 25% at 11:00 UTC. Will keep monitoring and hold off on 100% until we have +2h of stability.

Maya: :thumbsup:

Sasha: Thanks all — I'll update the changelog and close the ticket after the 2h stability window. :slightly_smiling_face:
